title: Feelings Beyond Friendship
content:
Several weeks passed.

Even though Siddu and Sneha were now living in different cities, the distance never affected their friendship.

Every week, without fail, they called each other.

They spoke about everything.

Their work...

Their daily lives...

The funny incidents they experienced...

And sometimes, they simply talked for hours without any particular reason.

With every passing conversation, their friendship grew stronger.

Slowly...

Without even realizing it...

Something inside Sneha began to change.

Whenever Siddu's name appeared on her phone, a smile would instantly find its way onto her face.

She started waiting for his calls.

Sometimes, she caught herself smiling for no reason at all... only to realize she had been thinking about Siddu.

Yet she never questioned those feelings.

She simply believed she was lucky to have a friend like him.

One evening, during one of their usual conversations, Sneha suddenly smiled.

"You know..."

"We've been talking for weeks."

"But we've never actually gone anywhere together."

Siddu chuckled.

"So... are you suggesting a trip?"

Sneha laughed.

"Maybe."

"Then let's do it," Siddu replied.

After discussing several places, they finally decided on one destination.

Jammu.

Since Sneha was staying in Delhi, Siddu planned to travel there first so they could begin their journey together.

A few days later...

Siddu packed his luggage, boarded the train, and arrived in Delhi.

He headed straight to the hotel where Sneha was staying.

After checking in, he walked into the hotel's ground-floor café and called her.

"I've reached."

"I'm waiting in the cafeteria."

Sneha's cheerful voice came through the phone.

"Perfect."

"Order coffee for both of us."

"I'll be there in a few minutes."

"Alright," Siddu replied.

A few minutes later, the waiter placed two cups of coffee on the table.

Just then...

Sneha walked into the café.

Dressed elegantly, with a gentle smile on her face, she looked different from the girl Siddu had met on the train months ago.

For a brief moment...

He simply looked at her.

Then a warm smile appeared on his face.

"That dress really suits you, Sneha."

Sneha stopped walking for a second.

Her heart skipped a beat.

A soft blush slowly spread across her cheeks.

"Th... thank you," she replied shyly.

Siddu noticed her flushed face.

Concern immediately replaced his smile.

He gently placed the back of his hand against her forehead.

"Are you alright?"

"Your face looks a little red."

The moment his hand touched her forehead, her heartbeat quickened. It was such a simple gesture... yet to her, it felt strangely special.

Her heartbeat raced.

For a moment...

She forgot how to respond.

Siddu frowned slightly.

"Maybe you're not feeling well."

"We can postpone the trip if you want."

Sneha quickly shook her head.

"No!"

"I mean..."

"I'm perfectly fine."

He looked at her suspiciously.

"Are you sure?"

She smiled awkwardly.

"Yes..."

"I'm sure, sir."

The word made both of them laugh.

The awkwardness disappeared almost instantly.

After finishing their coffee, they picked up their bags.

Together...

They stepped out of the hotel.

Completely unaware...

Neither of them realized...

That the journey they were about to begin wouldn't just take them to Jammu.

It would quietly take their friendship toward something neither of them had expected.
